failing_case: On this branch the committed gate log .relay/checks/14641bb680d75c953c314ca03897d08b7898c100.gate.log holds two runs: the first ends
"inert FAILED ... < inert FAILED", then a block of NUL bytes, then a second "inert FAILED ... > types and lint FAILED", exit 1.
b57daf1 (14641bb plus only that log) was green. run() opens the shared git-path relay-gate.out with "wb" and runs bin/ci in the same
worktree with no lock, so a second run truncates the first's output (the NULs are the first writer's offset) and both share .ci/.
Should: a second gate on a worktree whose gate is running is refused (or waits), and each log holds one run.
fix_hint: Take an exclusive lock (fcntl.flock on a file under the git dir, non-blocking) before running the gate command; refuse when held.
pass_cases: relay gate started while another relay gate runs in the same worktree is refused with a message naming the running one; the first run's log is whole.
A single relay gate run still writes and commits its log as today.
relay gate after a finished run on the same head still reuses a green log.
reason: Fixer reports it outside (relay_gate.py untouched); agreed.
findings.summary: two relay gate runs on one worktree share relay-gate.out and .ci/, so their logs interleave with NUL bytes and the inert step can go red
